Journey from academia to the dynamic world of healthtech, I’ve shifted from theoretical exploration to building solutions that impact real-world healthcare. My early days involved mastering foundational concepts, but the true growth came when I realized how machine learning could transform patient outcomes and operational efficiency.  

Current Focus  
At HealthAI Innovations, I’m driven by the intersection of cutting-edge AI and healthcare. My work revolves around developing scalable models that enhance diagnostic accuracy and streamline clinical workflows. Whether it’s refining NLP pipelines to extract insights from unstructured medical data or designing REST APIs to integrate AI tools into existing systems, the goal is always to bridge innovation with tangible value.  

Skills Highlight  
I thrive in environments where data meets impact—leveraging Apache Spark for large-scale ETL pipelines, TensorFlow and PyTorch for prototyping, and GCP for deploying models in production. My MLOps toolkit (MLflow, W&B) ensures reproducibility, while Hugging Face Transformers power natural language understanding in clinical contexts.  

Let’s connect if you’re shaping the future of healthtech—collaborating on solutions that turn data into care.
